task_metadata.research_topic: objective design for dexterous hand pose retargeting and inverse-kinematics-based teleoperation
task_metadata.research_question: Design a better optimization objective for retargeting human hand keypoint positions to robot hand joint angles across multiple dexterous hand morphologies.
notes: The task focuses on analytical retargeting objectives and gradients for multi-hand inverse kinematics rather than end-to-end policy learning.
Local repo metadata and MCP paper search support an exact paper link for the DexPilot baseline, but not for the generic upstream position/vector heuristics.
All three test scripts are linked to concrete papers about the evaluated robot hands or exact hardware platforms when available.

tests.label: allegro
tests.notes: No canonical Allegro Hand design paper was located in MCP search, so this test is linked to two Allegro-specific manipulation/control papers that use the exact hand platform.

tests.label: svh
tests.notes: Linked to a paper that explicitly evaluates grasping on the Schunk SVH five-finger hand.

tests.label: leap
tests.notes: Linked to the LEAP Hand hardware paper, which directly matches the robot used by this test.

baselines.name: position
baselines.notes: Implements the upstream PositionOptimizer-style Huber position objective, but the local repo and MCP search did not surface a standalone paper that exactly names this heuristic baseline.

baselines.name: vector
baselines.notes: Implements the upstream VectorOptimizer-style vector-matching heuristic. I did not find a concrete paper that exactly defines this baseline in the dex-retargeting package.

baselines.name: dexpilot
baselines.notes: Directly maps to the DexPilot objective with projected close-finger pair constraints for teleoperation.
